name: Two returns, no single heir

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest resolution; individual character choices vary

summary: The restored weapon returns to Dalaran by faction-specific roads. An Alliance seeker reports through Caladis and the Silver Covenant; a Horde seeker through Myralion and the Sunreavers. In the blood-elf sword branch, Aethas publicly presents the new bearer. Other characters unable to wield the sword receive a different weapon type. These are alternative game outcomes, not one champion’s combined history, and no named adventurer is made the canonical heir.
